en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large, multi-story historic building with a distinctive central gable and multiple turrets. The building is set against a backdrop of hills or low mountains. In the foreground, people are walking along paths across an open, grassy area. The text 'GRAZ' appears in the top left corner and 'Neue Landwehr Kaserne' in the top right, indicating the building's name.
